data.cultural_impact: The name Suma in Sanskrit language means "well-being" or "prosperity." In various aspects of Hindu culture, the name has been used to symbolize good fortune and happiness. In Hindu mythology, the name Suma is also associated with the goddess of wealth, Lakshmi, further emphasizing the blessings of prosperity and abundance. Indeed, the name Suma has been given to girls in hopes of bestowing upon them a life filled with happiness, good health, and prosperity.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Suma holds deep meaning in Hinduism. It signifies the constant presence of God and the divine blessings bestowed upon an individual. The name Suma encourages a life of gratitude, focusing on the favor of the divine rather than material possessions. It also symbolizes the pursuit of inner peace, happiness, and spiritual growth. By embracing this name, one is reminded to seek the favor of the divine in all aspects of life, trusting that the universe provides and allowing for grace and abundance in every moment.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Suma, derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sumangali,' signifies one who is blessed with good luck and auspiciousness. The name is believed to ward off evils and bring happiness and prosperity in one's life.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that The Rigveda mentions a goddess named Suma, associated with fertility and prosperity. The name Suma carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The name Suma is mentioned in the Rigveda, a sacred Hindu text, as a goddess associated with fertility and prosperity.
